quality.materiality_rule: Choose a side only for a meaningful difference in immediate goal advancement, emotional attunement, specific support, clarity, or burden; do not reward length or memory mention by itself.
quality.required_evidence: one concise comparative rationale grounded in the visible responses

function.projection: FUNCTIONAL only when all three are YES; deployed fallback is mechanically NONFUNCTIONAL

risk.role_in_this_phase: machine guards plus targeted literal-event inspection only; a paper-level absolute risk rate still requires independent overlap
